script.text: After Dennis revealed himself to be a spy, Yuya learned there was another visitor from the Fusion Dimension.
Sora! I gotta admit, I can't believe you're actually here!
Once I knew Zuzu wasn't at Duel Academy, I went back to your dimension to get Celina. And hopefully find Zuzu too.
But when I got there, it was too late. I learned that Celina and you Lancers left for another dimension.
So you came to Synchro looking for us?
Yeah. When I heard Dennis spill the beans about being from Fusion, his cover was blown. So I sent him back to Duel Academy.
Back to Duel Academy?! But Dennis will tell them that Zuzu and Celina are here!
It's time to face facts, Yuya. Obelisk Force will be here soon. And they're coming for Celina and Zuzu.
When I met you and Zuzu, I felt like I finally had my first real friends. That's why I won't let them get her. All you have to do is go get Celina and bring her to me!
Sora, why would I do that?
So that we can make a trade. You hand Celina over to me… and then you take Zuzu back home.
I can't just abandon Celina! Not Celina, not Zuzu! The Professor's not getting his way.
So Duel Academy is about to attack this city. No doubt they'll send Yuri. Wherever Yuri goes, destruction follows.
With Dennis' deceit, the duelists became distrustful of each other. Two such duelists faced each other in the next round of the Friendship Cup.
All the Lancers are traitors, including my next opponent.
Dennis can't be the only one. There must be others from Duel Academy that have infiltrated this dimension.
I can't trust anybody. I have to treat them all like the enemy.
